# Vendor V-OLD, its address written with the old keys `addr1` and `addr2`.
#
# Ledgers holding those keys exist, and they are still read as the first and
# second address lines. Books written by the release that wrote them also hold
# the lines in the vendor's slot, because vendors had no address setters then.
#
# What this fixture produces: vendor V-OLD with a two-line address.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_vendor_slot_holding_its_address_is_brought_up_to_date.py.
vendor "V-OLD"
	name: "Beta Printing"
	currency: CAD
	addr1: "Beta Printing Inc"
	addr2: "2 Rear Lane"
